text:
leila: heads up — noticed a batch of failed snapshot decrypts in prod after yesterday's RBAC cleanup. logs show KMS DENY on 3 snapshots across tenant=acme-inc. wondering if this is a policy revoke or a grant TTL issue. attaching a trimmed log below

leila: ```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z ERROR snapshot-restore service=backups request_id=abc123 tenant=acme-inc snapshot=snap-20260320-01 kms_status=AccessDenied KMSRequestId=xyz-987
```

hank: thx — can you paste the IAM change PR link? was there a mass role removal or a new deny rule?

leila: PR: https://github.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2981 — main change was removing legacy uploader role and switching to ephemeral grants for backup-agent. no explicit denies.

sam: oncall checking — I see ephemeral grant controller issued grants yesterday at 16:05 UTC and then a revoke job at 17:30 for the same resources (looks like a bug in policy reconciliation).

sam: quick check: are the snapshots encrypted with per-tenant CMKs or our shared CMK?

leila: acme snapshots use customer-CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/aaaaaaaa. backup-agent should have had an ephemeral grant to use that key.

ana: (typo — meant ana) ana: FYI - encops-bot alerted on grant TTL mismatch at 17:25, thread id #encops-568. I forwarded to oncall.

encops-bot: Automated alert: grant_controller: grant_expiry_mismatch detected for key aaaaaaaa at 2026-03-20T17:25:22Z. Candidate cause: reconciliation loop with stale desired state.

hank: ok probable sequence: RBAC cleanup removed static role, ephemeral controller created grants but then reconciliation immediately pruned them because desired state didn't include the new agent principal (race). restores after 17:30 would fail with AccessDenied.

hank: immediate mitigation: 1) re-issue a short-lived grant for backup-agent for that CMK (30m) 2) pause grant_reconciler for acme tenant 3) run test restore on staging key

sam: I've re-issued a grant (grant id g-20260320-01) and paused the reconciler for acme. Confirmed restored one snapshot to staging successfully.

leila: thanks. two followups: - audit logs for KMS need clearer correlation id so we can link grant lifecycle events to restore failures. currently we have KMSRequestId but not controller-run-id. - need a playbook entry for ephemeral grants failing mid-rotation

hank: agree. I'll file a small task: infra#3010 add controller-run-id to grant creation metadata and emit it in audit log events. Also add a one-page playbook under eng-security playbooks.

ana: ana: can you update compliance ticket to note this incident and attach recovered snapshots list? we might need to notify acme depending on SLA.

ana: ana: ack, will update SRC-1123 and ping customer success for notification guidance.

leila: quick root-cause note for incident: reconciliation race after RBAC cleanup caused ephemeral grant TTL mismatch which led to AccessDenied from KMS for in-flight snapshot restores. Remediation: manual grant reissue, paused reconciler, added logging task.

hank: assigning followups: infra#3010 (add run-id), secops#44 (playbook + runbook), oncall: add a canary to grant controller to detect TTL churn.

sam: +1. closing the thread once infra#3010 and secops#44 are linked in the ticket. :thumbsup:

leila: thanks all — will drop a short blameless postmortem in incidents channel tomorrow with timelines and test artifacts.
